key: Is it still going on outside?
en: Is it still going on outside?

key: If it can be of any service to you, please buy something to help drive them away!
en: If it can be of any service to you, please buy something to help drive them away!
ja: お役に立てるなら、何か買って連中を追い払う足しにしてくださいな!

key: Take the TV, take the sofa, just let me live afterwards...
en: Take the TV, take the sofa, just let me live afterwards...
ja: テレビでもソファでも持っていっていいから、あとで生かしておいてくれ……
しー、ここに隠れてるんだから!

key: But if any Team Meteors show up, we're gonna get 'em!
en: But if any Team Meteors show up, we're gonna get 'em!
ja: でもメテオ団のやつが来たら、やっつけてやるんだから!

key: You're not with the bad guys, right?
en: You're not with the bad guys, right?
ja: あなた、悪い連中の仲間じゃないよね?

key: I feel like I went from a bad dream to a nightmare...
en: I feel like I went from a bad dream to a nightmare...
ja: 悪い夢から、もっとひどい悪夢に変わった気分だわ……

key: There's nothing quite as stressful as sleeping half my youth away and then going through a life threatening event immediately after!
en: There's nothing quite as stressful as sleeping half my youth away and then going through a life threatening event immediately after!
ja: 青春の半分を寝て過ごした挙句、直後に命の危険にさらされるなんて、これ以上ストレスなことはないわ!

key: Time to ease my troubles in the preferred method of the corporate overlords!
en: Time to ease my troubles in the preferred method of the corporate overlords!
ja: さあ、企業様お墨付きのやり方で憂さ晴らしといこうかな!
